The archived 1902 Breviarium is the first candidate, but no exact Salve/Compline locator is currently recorded.

uses.claim: The source prints and identifies Deus, refúgium nostrum.
uses.decision_reason: Retain with correction. The live about text does not claim that Leo XIII authored this collect; it calls it the collect of the prayers of Leo XIII, locates it after Salve Regina and its versicle, and summarizes content visible in the text. The inspected Enchiridion page supports that identity and order. Harden the public locator to n. 675, printed p. 520, PDF scan 541, and do not broaden the wording to authorship.
